edits.old:
if interaction = 14850:
	$interaction_type = 'prisoner_torture'
	torture_intensity = 4
	compassion = 1
	sensitivity_threshold = 3
	torturer_skill = master_torture
	$special_part = {
		$play_sound[1] = $cry[slave['age']]
		$text[1] = $prisoner_hanged_description
		$text[2] = $compassion_reaction[$slave_psy_status]
		if no_guro = 1:
			$bg_path = ''
		else
			$bg_path = func('display_pic', 'prisoner', 'hanging', 'girls/torture_scenes/get_rid_of/', 'any_age')
		end
		dynamic $clear_slave_instance, 'prisoner' &! PRISONER DEATH
		if slave['threat_death'] > 0:
			! threat fulfilled (slave now believes threat is real)
			slave['threat_death'] = 0
		end
		if slave_already_done_total[$str(interaction)] = 0: slave['instinct'] += 2 &! slave gains two full levels of taming the first time they witness an execution
		if slave['compassion'] > 0:
			! compassionate slave maxes fear, clears all positive moodlets
			slave['fear'] = 5
			gs '$mood_drop', 'slave', 100 &! traumatic
		elseif slave['compassion'] < 0:
			! sadistic slave gains devotion, clears all negative moodlets
			slave_rate['moral'] += slave['ego']*slave['temper']
			gs '$mood_rise', 'slave', 100 &! exciting
		else
			slave['fear'] += 1 &! non-sadist/non-compassionate slave is less affected but still gains a level of fear
		end
	}
	if dungeon > 0: $place = 'dungeon'
end
